using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Args;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Commands;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Tests.Commands;

public class GenerateRazorPageTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task ExecuteAsync_Should_Log_Information_When_Files_Are_Generated()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<GenerateRazorPage>>();
        var command = new GenerateRazorPageTestImpl(mockLogger.Object);
        command.SetupMainCoreReturnValue(new List<RazorPageGeneratorResult>
        {
            new RazorPageGeneratorResult { FilePath = "test1.Designer.cs", GeneratedCode = "code1" },
            new RazorPageGeneratorResult { FilePath = "test2.Designer.cs", GeneratedCode = "code2" }
        });

        var commandLineArgs = new CommandLineArgs();

        // Act
        await command.ExecuteAsync(commandLineArgs);

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogInformation(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg == "2 files successfully generated."),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                null),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private class GenerateRazorPageTestImpl : GenerateRazorPage
    {
        private readonly List<RazorPageGeneratorResult> _mainCoreReturnValue;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<GenerateRazorPage>> _loggerMock;

        public GenerateRazorPageTestImpl(Mock<ILogger<GenerateRazorPage>> loggerMock)
        {
            Logger = loggerMock.Object;
            _loggerMock = loggerMock;
            _mainCoreReturnValue = new List<RazorPageGeneratorResult>();
        }

        public void SetupMainCoreReturnValue(List<RazorPageGeneratorResult> returnValue)
        {
            _mainCoreReturnValue.Clear();
            _mainCoreReturnValue.AddRange(returnValue);
        }

        private new List<RazorPageGeneratorResult> MainCore(RazorProjectEngine projectEngine, string targetProjectDirectory)
        {
            return _mainCoreReturnValue;
        }
    }
}
